title: Private Boat Trip or Yacht Charter in Madeira: What Is the Difference?
description: A private boat trip is a few hours on a small skippered boat for your group. A yacht charter is a bigger boat with cabins and crew, often for a day or more.
heroAlt: A small white motor boat passing a large three deck motor yacht moored in Funchal harbour
keywords: difference between a private boat trip and a yacht charter in Madeira
boat for a large group Madeira

images.prompt: Mid-morning in Funchal harbour, Madeira, seen from the water at a low angle. In the background a large white three deck motor yacht is moored along the outer harbour wall, its tinted windows catching the sun. In the foreground, a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy passes slowly from left to right with a small wake, three guests on board seen small from the side and behind. The amphitheatre of Funchal's white houses and green hills rises behind. Natural light, true colours, no text, no logos.
